items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: And so we had Ricky bring his clarinet to play the part that Jimmy Noone would have played.

ctx.x: We went to New Orleans, right after Jimmy Noone died. Because we were supposed to do this New Orleans Jazz Festival. And Jimmy Noone died in April, no, March, and we were supposed to be there in April. And so we had Ricky bring his clarinet to play the part that Jimmy Noone would have played. And Ricky started playing “Ain’t Nobody’s Business” he’s got this thing, and all of a sudden he took his clarinet out, his mouthpiece and he looked at it and then he started playing, and it sounded just like Jimmy Noone.…
Jimmy Noone was playing through him.
